about_the_game:
Real-time In-Game Voice + Voice Wheel! Your Ultimate Weapon for Real-Time Voice Combat!

Tired of boring open-mic conversations? Want to create fun moments or relay tactics precisely in games? FanYan ShuYu is here! It’s a fun and practical real-time audio assistant tool. Its core charm: let you speak with your custom voice lines in real time during any competitive game—League of Legends, CS:GO, DOTA 2, Apex Legends, and more!

No complicated sound cards, no professional voice changers. Just use the wheel / double‑click dual mode and prank or communicate with one click!

🎮 Brand-New Quick Voice Wheel: Send Lines in Team Fights with Just Your Fingertip

All-new in-game floating mini voice wheel:

  • Doesn’t block your view, no need to switch windows

  • Tap lightly to play voice lines instantly!

In high-tempo moments—team fights, defending positions, ambushes, calling locations—no fumbling for buttons, no interrupting movement. Tap and play instantly!

Wheel Collection Mode

Add collections to the wheel and group similar voice lines together. Tap the wheel to play random audio from the collection—no repeats. Say goodbye to getting tired of common lines or ignoring rare ones.

🎤 Core Feature: One Click to Speak, Sound Like You’re Right There

Ultra-simple operation, dual modes for endless fun:

  • Wheel Mode: Floating trigger in-game, perfect for team fights

  • Double‑Click Mode: Quick selection on desktop, great for large libraries

Voice is instantly sent to your active game, voice chat (Discord, YY), or any app that uses a microphone—smooth and natural, just like you’re speaking yourself!

Build Your Exclusive Voice Arsenal

Over 1,000+ professionally recorded voice lines from Sad Little Sweet Potato! Covers:

  • Kill highlights

  • Tilted rants

  • Victory cheers

  • Tactical commands

  • Team encouragement

  • All in-game scenarios, with free ongoing updates!

Master of Emotion: Express Precisely

Just for “Nice!”, we have dozens of tones:

  • Lazy taunt, excited crack, calm approval, ecstatic shout

    One perfectly matches your mood right now!

    Group similar emotional lines into collections for random playback—full of surprises and maximum atmosphere.

Want something unique? Import external audio (supports MP3 / WAV)! Classic memes, custom quotes, exclusive sound effects—all into your loadout, creating a one-of-a-kind voice arsenal.

🚀 Powerful Features, Smooth Gaming

Steam Cloud Save Sync

Sync playlists across multiple PCs! Your custom playlists are automatically synced via Steam Cloud, keeping you battle-ready anywhere.

(Save path: Install directory > “save” folder)

Wide Compatibility

Fully works with all PC games and communication software that support microphone input — plug and play.

🤝 Join Us and Evolve Together

Problems? Amazing voice ideas? Join our player community!

Feedback & QQ Group: 854878932

Your suggestions directly shape future voice updates and features!

▶️ Act Now and Explode the In-Game Social Scene!

Let your custom voice lines become your signature weapon on the battlefield!

Get ready for amazement and confusion from your teammates!

short_description: PotatoVoice is a powerful voice playback app for all games and voice chat software. It features a floating voice wheel comparable to in-game built-in ones, supporting collection sorting, unlimited custom voice imports, and wheel/double-click modes, bringing you a brand-new in-game voice experience.
